As FMC is not being held at [Rubik's Irish Championship 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksIrishChampionship2025), this is your chance to become Ireland's Fewest Moves Champion! Please see all the tabs to see the locations and information of each venue. *You do not need to attend Rubik's Irish Championship 2025 in Waterford to become the Irish FMC National Champion.* ## This competition is not recommended for newcomers **Please Note:** As this is the Irish Championship, only competitors who represent Ireland will be eligible for prizes.
